accurate_go.desc: Ancestra accurate + gene order (MAIN, fresh e2e)

accurate_go_rescue.desc: accurate + gene order + family rescue (3Di+profile) + guard

runtime.note: orthofinder -f <12 proteomes> -t 8 -a 8 -mog (default: DIAMOND, MSA/famsa+FastTree gene trees, MCL I=1.2); node load avg ~20-55 on 24 cores

sonicparanoid -m default -t 8 -I 1.5 (diamond very-sensitive, domain-arch step on). Includes one-time Pfam profile DB indexing at first run after install (few minutes). Node load avg ~20-55 on 24 cores
proteinortho -p=diamond -cpus=8 (defaults: e=1e-5, identity 25, coverage 50, conn 0.1, purity; PoFF off). Input proteomes had internal '*' stop symbols stripped (sed, required by ProteinOrtho)

FastOMA 0.5.1 nextflow pipeline (local, no container), OMAmer 2.1.0 + LUCA.h5 (OMAmer DB, OMA-derived: LEAKAGE - OMA contains these species), nextflow executor cpus=8. wall includes omamer search (12 x 1 cpu), nextflow overhead + report notebook; peak RSS = largest single process
